notes: MXB Race Day Live v0.5.4: deep MX Bikes extension integration plus stay-open hot updating. Race Day Live now watches the native game profile/content roots, mirrors bike/paint/kit changes, captures full race loadouts, reapplies the saved native loadout before one-click direct-connect, and replaces the fake Garage bike flow with an MX Bikes-style Bike Selection mirror that writes directly to profile.ini. This version also installs the new hot updater so updates after v0.5.4 install and refresh inside the existing window without closing/restarting.
